criterion_text: With a Server-hosted OCI Registry, a Session-authorized Agent obtains the correct immutable Image through the unified SDK and locally caches/consumes it without using proprietary download URLs; an unauthorized agent/repository is denied and existing Session pins survive tag moves.

verifiers.summary: SC-02: a Session-authorized Agent fetches the immutable Image via Server /v2/ through the unified SDK/cache (no proprietary URL), caches/consumes it, denies an unauthorized repository, and its Session pin survives a tag move
